interpretation: E4 top-2 adaptive routing is worse than its frozen control. Noise 0.001 and image routing retain only small learned-over-frozen mean differences, and neither produces a strong randomized-route dependence signal. Fixed expert partitions or ordinary optimization regularization remain more plausible than useful adaptive conditional computation at epoch 5.
alternative_explanation: A useful learned router may require a different geometry or expert-bank size; the corrected linear E4/E8/E16 and E8 top-2 pairs are the immediate bounded tests.
sharp_falsifier: A corrected linear or top-2 learned/frozen pair must show a materially larger mean-plus-tail learned advantage and route reliance above 0.01 without collapse; otherwise this short family is not promoted.
multiplicity: All short screens are exploratory seed 0 after many comparisons. Configuration-mismatch attempts are preserved but excluded from intended-configuration claims; corrected winners would still require locked fresh-seed confirmation.
